question.:question/problem: if $a=⟨8,10⟩$, then  what is the magnitude of  $a?$
question.:question/worked-solution:

$$
\begin{aligned}|\,a\,| & =\sqrt{{a}_{x}^{2}+{a}_{y}^{2}} \\  & =\sqrt{(8)^{2}+(10)^{2}} \\  & =\sqrt{64+100} \\  & =\sqrt{164} \\  & =\sqrt{4\cdot 41} \\  & =2\sqrt{41}.\end{aligned}
$$
